site.description: Rishav Sharma — data scientist. Work, things built, and short explanations of the ideas behind them.
site.intro: I teach and build on Palantir Foundry at Ontologize. Before that I spent three years at Swiss Re in Bengaluru building machine-learning and language-model pipelines for underwriters, and before that I taught Python online and studied operational research at the University of Delhi.
